Senses.Explanation: A hall-address pivot that summons the one phrase answerable to this very hour of the year. Feiyin Tongrong, sending Miyun's robe into the stupa, asks for the phrase that answers the hour and hands over willow silk on the jade railing; Baichi Xingyuan, at a layman's feast praying for an heir, strikes his whisk and shows the auspicious star appearing; Eryin Mi, on Amitabha's birthday, concedes that even the all-good days need a phrase for the season and pours out frost-jade cliffs and golden chrysanthemums; and Guantao Daqi, at the beginning of spring, lets the snow-shaded daylilies and spring-leaking willow twigs answer for him. Yikui Yuankui's winter-night xiaocan rules the hearers' flowering minds fit for the solstice hour while doubting his own telling; Tianyin Yuanxiu's lantern-festival address stops long and shows the snow melting into spring water on the cliff; Lianfeng Su finds Zhaozhou's tea and Yunmen's cakes fit for the season while cracked basins and dung-chunks fly where they please; and Lianyue Daozheng, closing the summer seat, invites the whole hall to answer the hour hand in hand and, when all withhold, drags his staff and scatters them himself.
